_doc: Hand corrections to auto-detected watch boxes: "<page>:<k>" (k = 1-based position of the record on its page, reading order) -> [x, y, w, h] normalised to the page, margin included; null = no photo. Oct 2026: p4 and p9 had one watch split in two by the detector (halves merged); the ring watches on p31-p32 are below the detector's minimum photo height (re-detected with min_h=0.04); p33 pocket watch set by hand to include the bow; 11:5 and 16:3 extended to the bracelet end, 17:3 cut above the caption. All other boxes are the stock detector's, every page checked on its check sheet. Source: .pilot/1972-1972-seiko-catalogue/work/overrides.py
